payload.title: Anth.us knowledge base as a private pod
payload.description:
Anth.us stays a cloud newsroom. Its knowledge-base repository (46 story folders) becomes a private typed pod that may feed the newsroom: type the finished articles, then first feed into the Anth.us newsroom after the Pilobolus load. Once a record is edited in the newsroom the newsroom owns it. Permanent ids live on the owner's own address.

**Acceptance criteria**
- The pod passes pod check and loads privately; nothing is published by the load.
- First feed into the Anth.us newsroom runs after the Pilobolus wiki load.
- Uses Gherkin features from slices 12 and 13.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.
